data.title: Autumn Break in AlUla Blends Nature, History, Culture
data.content:
AlUla, November 22, 2026, SPA -- AlUla Governorate offers experiences that combine the exploration of nature with the discovery of history, where visitors can engage with its archaeological sites, unique rock formations, and lush oases.
    They can also enjoy a variety of cultural, recreational, and sporting activities, including neighborhood sports facilities, cycling and equestrian trails, and diverse hospitality options.
    During the autumn break, events are hosted across various locations, including art exhibitions, cultural showcases, and stargazing programs led by expert guides in areas free from light pollution.
    Air and land travel options make AlUla accessible from various parts of the Kingdom and beyond, while the "AlUla Moments" platform allows visitors to follow the event schedule through its website.
    -- SPA
